newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch options turnover surged 69 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Dutch options turnover surged 69 percent in 1996.

text.p: AMSTERDAM, Dec 30 - European Options Exchange (EOE) turnover surged by 69 percent to 28.5 million contracts in 1996, the EOE said on Monday, adding that 1995 had been a record year.
Average daily turnover in 1996 totalled 112,600 contracts.
The EOE said October was the busiest month in its history with more than three million contracts traded. October 18 was the busiest trading day with turnover of over 350,000 contracts.
By the end of today, the last trading day of the year, the EOE had more than 3.5 million contracts outstanding.
The EOE said trading in options contracts rose to 26.9 million contracts in the current year, up 70 percent from 1995's 15.8 million.
The number of futures traded went up to 1.5 million from last year's 1.1 million.
